steps.en: Install from your platform's package set (or build from the tarball)
steps.zh: 用系统包源安装（或从 tarball 构建）

steps.en: Start a session before the long-running thing begins
steps.zh: 在长任务开始前沿起一个 session

steps.en: Spawns a server that owns the pseudo-terminals and the status line
steps.zh: 拉起一个 server，掌管所有伪终端和底部状态栏

steps.en: Add a window, split it, run the build or the agent inside
steps.zh: 开 window、分屏，把构建或 agent 放进去跑

steps.en: Keeps every process alive through SSH timeouts and closed terminals
steps.zh: SSH 超时、终端关闭，所有进程照跑

steps.en: Tomorrow, reattach and pick up exactly where you left
steps.zh: 第二天重连，画面原样接上

value.en: Dropped connections and dead terminal windows stop killing server-side work — with one small C binary and nothing to babysit
value.zh: 断线、终端先死，再也不杀服务端任务——一个小的 C 二进制，没有要伺候的东西

sources: README (Dependencies: libevent 2.x + ncurses; build from release tarball: ./configure && make; sudo make install; platforms OpenBSD/FreeBSD/NetBSD/Linux/macOS/Solaris)

man tmux.1 DESCRIPTION (started creates a new session with a single window; status line at the bottom; session = collection of pseudo terminals; survives accidental disconnection such as ssh connection timeout or intentional detaching with C-b d)
man tmux.1 example ($ tmux attach; $ tmux neww \; splitw)
man tmux.1 (prefix key C-b; C-b d detach)
